subject: pathology
title: Malakoplakia, Rhinosporidiosis, Mycetoma, and Special Stains

steps.tx: Malakoplakia presents as soft yellow bladder, kidney, or gut plaques in immunocompromised hosts, where macrophages stuffed with incompletely digested bacteria form sheets of von Hansemann cells. Its name literally means soft plaque, and the lesion is **malakoplakia**, most often provoked by Escherichia coli.
steps.say: Soft yellow plaques in the bladder of an immunocompromised patient should make you biopsy for malakoplakia.

vis.caption: Malakoplakia endoscopic plaques and histopathology with Michaelis-Gutmann bodies.

steps.tx: Under the microscope, periodic acid Schiff positive granules and von Kossa positive targetoid bodies confirm the digestion failure, because residual bacterial debris mineralises with iron and calcium inside phagolysosomes. Antibiotics that penetrate macrophages and correcting immunosuppression treat the cause; the confirmatory body remains the **Michaelis-Gutmann body**.
steps.say: PAS positive granules and mineralised Michaelis-Gutmann bodies confirm macrophages that cannot finish digesting bacteria.

left.title: Malakoplakia
points: Associated with E coli and immunosuppression

steps.tx: Rhinosporidiosis grows friable red nasal and conjunctival polyps in patients exposed to stagnant water, and its huge sporangia packed with endospores are unmistakable on sections from endemic regions including India and Sri Lanka. Surgical excision with cautery of the base treats **rhinosporidiosis**, caused by Rhinosporidium seeberi.
steps.say: A bleeding strawberry nasal polyp after pond exposure in South Asia is rhinosporidiosis until histology says otherwise.

steps.tx: Mycetoma is a chronic swelling of foot or hand with discharging sinuses whose grains reveal the culprit, black grains for fungi, white or yellow for filamentous bacteria, demanding years of antimicrobials or surgery. The clinical triad is swelling, sinuses, and **mycetoma grains**.
steps.say: Swelling, discharging sinuses, and grains spell mycetoma; the grain colour separates fungal from bacterial causes.

vis.caption: Mycetoma with swelling, sinus tracts, and grains in affected foot tissue.

steps.tx: Special stains are chosen like keys for locks: PAS paints fungal walls and basement membranes magenta through carbohydrate richness, and methenamine silver blackens fungi and Pneumocystis against green. The carbohydrate stain is **periodic acid Schiff (PAS)**, diastase controlled when glycogen is questioned.
steps.say: PAS stains fungal walls magenta; reach for it whenever carbohydrates or fungal walls need proving.

steps.tx: Mucicarmine stains the thick cryptococcal capsule deep rose, separating Cryptococcus from other yeasts in meninges and lung, while Alcian blue offers a modern alternative in capsule deficient variants. The capsule stain is **mucicarmine**, a small test with decisive answers. India ink preparation offers a bedside alternative for cerebrospinal fluid in suspected meningitis cases.
steps.say: Mucicarmine paints the cryptococcal capsule rose red and settles the yeast identification in one glance.

steps.tx: Gram, Ziehl-Neelsen, Fite, Warthin-Starry, and Steiner stains each chase a bacterial family, spirochaetes and Bartonella darkening with silver methods where routine stains fail. Choosing the stain from the clinical suspicion is applied microbiology at the microscope: **special stain selection**. Warthin-Starry also displays the bacilli of cat scratch disease and bacillary angiomatosis beautifully.
steps.say: Order stains from suspicion: silver for spirochaetes and fungi, Fite for leprosy, Ziehl-Neelsen for tuberculosis.

nodes.label: Select PAS, GMS, AFB, or silver stain
Culture or molecular test confirms species

steps.tx: The unifying moral of this lesson is that chronic suppurating or plaque lesions in immunocompromised hosts reward biopsy with stains before empiric escalation, because malakoplakia mimics cancer endoscopically and mycetoma mimics tumour on imaging. Tissue with the right stain ends arguments; that habit is **biopsy before escalation**.
steps.say: Plaques and swellings that mimic cancer deserve biopsy with special stains before anyone escalates empiric therapy.
